name: engagement-os
description: Engagement OS — a composable operating system for document-heavy consulting engagements: research-only, bid-only, delivery-only, or both

plugins.name: engagement-os
plugins.description: Composable operating system for consulting engagements. Pursuit: rfp-analyze → bid-research → bid-respond. Delivery: scaffold → ingest → canonicalize → findings → validate → build, with a panel review gate. Scaffold only the blocks you need (research / pursuit / delivery / full, pursuit variant full-rfp / mini-comp); source material is bucketed by confidentiality constraint. Every stage separately invokable, including the standalone render (eng-render). eng-* skills + playbook commands + templates + scripts, with a fixture-tested lint.

plugins.name: deck-craft
plugins.description: Client-grade deck and figure craft. presentation-builder turns a body of context into a full deck with a real storyline and action titles; designing-figures picks the archetype before anything is drawn, so a figure stops coming out as one cramped row of boxes. Used on its own, or as the render end of engagement-os.

plugins.name: consulting-suite
plugins.description: Install-everything bundle for document-heavy consulting work: the engagement operating system, the panel review gate, deck and figure craft, and the Office document skills. Ships no components of its own — installing it resolves and installs the four plugins it depends on, and skips any you already have.
